notices: HISTORICAL BACKTEST: rolling-origin re-forecasts of past days from a frozen data snapshot, refitted at every origin with data through that origin only and scored against the recorded actuals. Not prospective validation.

The legacy 4.93 % MAPE is a one-step-ahead (h = 1) score with observed lags on one 90-day block (2026-04-02..2026-06-30), from a single fit. It is a different procedure from the recursive forecasts evaluated here; only the legacy-holdout comparison window puts the two side by side on the same target days.
The confirmation period was used to confirm the recommended model; scores on it are historical, not prospective.

On M2's confirmation period the recommended model's lead over the best baseline (H1) is not statistically established: MAE difference -127 requests/day (interval -256 to +2), Holm-adjusted p 0.054, not below 0.05.
The selected intervals FAILED the pre-registered calibration criteria on the historical evaluation period: these intervals and probabilities are not decision-grade.

data.recommendation_reason: Confirmed: atlas_linear_regression is not worse than same_weekday_median_5w on the confirmation period.

selection.rule: Pre-registered: candidates ['naive', 'seasonal_naive', 'same_weekday_mean_4w', 'same_weekday_median_5w', 'seasonal_exponential_smoothing', 'atlas_linear_regression']; selection period development; MAE over horizons 1..30 on forecasts common to all eligible candidates; failure rate above 0 makes a candidate ineligible; the best regression is selected only if its MAE is at least 3 % below the best baseline's and the DM test (conservative p) is below 0.05; otherwise the best baseline.
selection.reason: atlas_linear_regression beats the best baseline same_weekday_median_5w by at least 3 % in MAE and the selection-period DM test is significant at 0.05.

primary_tests.hypothesis: H1: best development regression vs best development baseline
H2: selected model vs the seasonal-naive reference

data.multiplicity: Holm adjustment over the primary family; every other test is exploratory and unadjusted.

models.description: Last observed value: yhat(o+h) = y(o) for every horizon.
Horizon-correct seasonal naive: yhat(o+h) = y(o + h - m*ceil(h/m)), the most recent observed day one or more whole seasons before the target.
Mean of the 4 most recent observed values on the target's weekday (on or before the origin).
Median of the 5 most recent observed values on the target's weekday (on or before the origin).
Additive seasonal exponential smoothing ETS(A,N,A), weekly season, smoothing parameters chosen from a fixed grid by in-sample one-step squared error.

Faithful legacy notebook regression: 32 collinear features, minimum-norm least squares with intercept (scikit-learn LinearRegression semantics), recursive 30-day procedure with clip-at-0 and integer rounding before feedback.
Modernised regression atlas-m2-regression-v1: 18 non-collinear M1 features plus intercept, OLS on standardised columns (full rank required), recursive, clipped at 0.
